struct Runner {
  func inOrder<T>(_ items: some Sequence<T>, reason: String, _ step: (T) async throws -> Void) async rethrows {
    for item in items {
      try await step(item)
    }
  }
}

func use() async throws {
  try await Runner().inOrder([], reason: "Each update reads the previous write") { value in print(value) }
}
